35/S0.subgoal: Explain the role of requirement gathering in ensuring usability for interactive systems.

35/S1.subgoal: Compare System-Centered Design (SCD) and User-Centered Design (UCD).

35/S2.subgoal: Distinguish between functional, feasibility, and end-user requirements that ensure usability.

35/S3.subgoal: Explain how usability requirements are classified as non-functional attributes, particularly related to interface issues.

35/S4.subgoal: State the core principle of knowing the user and define usability using the ISO standard.

35/S5.subgoal: Describe the Contextual Inquiry method and explain its practical importance in gathering end-user requirements.

35/S6.subgoal: Summarize the importance of usability requirement gathering and preview the next lecture content.
